name: Manchow Soup
steps: Finely chop cabbage, carrot, capsicum, ginger, garlic and chilli. Separate spring onion whites from greens. Mix cornflour with 60 ml of the measured cold water.
Heat oil in a saucepan. Stir-fry ginger, garlic, chilli and onion whites for 1 minute, then add the remaining chopped vegetables and stir over medium-high heat for 3 minutes.
Add the remaining water, soy sauce, pepper and salt. Simmer for 7 minutes until vegetables are tender but not mushy. Taste before adding any more salt because soy sauce is salty.

Stir the slurry and pour in while mixing. Simmer for 2–3 minutes until slightly thickened, add vinegar and onion greens, then divide into bowls. Add crispy noodles only at serving so they stay crunchy.
notes: Base recipe for 4 adults. Cooking times are estimates; follow the texture and doneness cues. Jain suitability follows your saved ingredient choices.
